method: Estimated: dishes come from the restaurant's real menu (source recorded). Calories/macros are estimated from typical recipes and portion sizes using USDA FoodData Central generic foods. They are not restaurant-provided and can be off by 20-30%. Allergen tags (incl. tomato, fresh fruit, carrot) are "likely" based on typical recipes — always ask your server.
